interaction: Tap one of four tone cards (mā 妈, má 麻, mǎ 马, mà 骂) to hear a synthesised voice glide along that tone's pitch contour while a red dot rides the line, then play a five-round quiz: hear a mystery tone, pick the matching contour and collect red stars. Hover or tap 学 好 中 文 on the practice sheet for pinyin, meaning, stroke count and example words, and switch every string on the page between English and 中文.
notes: Sound is Web Audio synthesis (sawtooth through formant filters) that plays only after a tap; the Sound on/off toggle silences it immediately. The enrol form ends in a demo message. Teachers, fees and term dates are fictional samples. The page is about 90 KB because every string ships in both languages; pinyin uses the system font because the web-font macron glyphs render misplaced.
